profile.bio: A motivated and enthusiastic student with a strong academic background and an interest in practical learning. Possesses good communication, teamwork, and organizational skills, and gains valuable professional experience

hobby.description: Gliding outdoors on skates - balancing, turning and picking up speed. It is fun, it keeps me fit, and it is a good way to clear my head after classes.
Cycling on open roads and around the neighbourhood - fresh air, exercise and a simple way to get around while enjoying the ride.
Settling in with popcorn to watch a film or a series, from crime thrillers to comedies. A relaxing way to unwind and enjoy a good story.

movie.title: Euphoria
movie.why_i_love_it: I love Euphoria because it tells the truth about being young, about friendship, mistakes and trying to find yourself. The characters feel real, and the way it is filmed makes every episode stay with me long after it ends.

movie.title: A Different World
movie.why_i_love_it: As a university student myself, I love watching life at Hillman College, the friendships, the laughter and the lessons about growing up away from home. Whitley and Dwayne's story is my favourite part, it feels close to real student life.

movie.title: Nemesis
movie.why_i_love_it: Nemesis keeps me guessing from the start, with old scores, family feuds and betrayal catching up fast. I enjoy crime stories where you have to think along, and the tension and the London setting make me want to watch it again.

movie.title: Never Have I Ever
movie.why_i_love_it: Never Have I Ever makes me laugh and feel at the same time. Devi is funny, stubborn and trying her best, and the show reminds me that growing up is messy for everyone.

movie.title: Bridgerton
movie.why_i_love_it: Bridgerton is pure enjoyment, the dresses, the music, the balls and the romance of Regency London. It is the show I watch when I want to relax and escape into a beautiful world.
